treatment.logline: A driver enclosed by wet Colombo hears a personal plea, receives a new destination, and lets a glance at his wrist precede an unexplained change of course.

arc.beat: Work encloses the private life represented on the dashboard.
The recorded message holds Dinu without producing an answer.
An incoming connection replaces personal urgency with authority.
The wrist glance precedes compliance but explains nothing.

treatment.approach: An approximately 86-second must bin built from contained handheld vehicle coverage, not exterior spectacle. Twelve clips supply the sustained master, listener singles and essential visible details needed to shape a 90-second scene from sparse scripted time. Repeated coverage of L3 and L5 is editorial choice, not repeated playback in the intended cut. Keep the two remote voices off screen. Establish the faded photograph before recorded audio enters; distinguish the later incoming connection with its phone cue.

treatment.geography: Stay inside the driver's compartment of the cash van. Dinu remains seated at the wheel; forward travel stays consistent through the windscreen. Dashboard and photograph remain ahead of him. Choose the red thread on his left wrist and the phone secured in a dashboard cradle within his reach; no hand-held phone operation while driving. Passenger-side camera positions maintain one screen axis. Do not establish an arrival or a specific junction.
treatment.key_image: Dinu's eyes drop toward the red thread on the hand already at the wheel, then return to the road before the van changes course.
advice: Do not diagnose the thread or Dinu's decision.
Use one uninterrupted instance of each remote line, selecting picture freely beneath it.
No music cue resolves the pressure; rain and cabin vibration carry the scene.
The photograph is a faded printed image, not a cut to either photographed person.

moments.what: Dinu receives L3 without a visible response in words.
moments.cut_uses: A close listener reaction carries the primary L3 picture; a medium listener and cabin master cover the entire same line for uninterrupted editorial choice. Use the spare coverage for the line's landing, not three repetitions.

moments.cut_uses: A dashboard phone detail identifies the incoming connection; the brief cue separates it from recorded playback.

moments.cut_uses: Close passenger-side reaction carries the directive; a wider listener single covers the same complete line and gives an unforced landing.

moments.what: Dinu looks toward the red thread and then steers toward the industrial area.
moments.feeling: A private hesitation followed by observable compliance.
moments.cut_uses: Medium-close single includes his eyes and left wrist for the glance; cabin master follows with the directional change. These are consecutive parts of the action, not repeated gestures.

editor_notes: The 86-second must bin supports the 90-second scene target; its overlapping coverage is raw material, not 86 seconds of unique chronological action. Let the editor shape duration from the held driving and reaction material without repeating either line.
Opening master and baseline single establish the passenger-side axis. The photograph detail is an essential scripted reveal; keep it established before the recorded audio starts.

L3 is complete in c05, c06 and c07 and L5 is complete in c09 and c10. These are matching listener pictures under a single uninterrupted instance of each remote line, not multiple playbacks; use the separate source recordings, appropriately filtered, and do not generate visible speech.

The phone is secured in an assumed dashboard cradle and the thread is assigned to Dinu's left wrist because the packet does not specify their exact placement. Both hands stay on the wheel. Do not invent an on-screen answering action.
The incoming screen detail is c08, setup H. Composite the caller ID if generative text is unreliable; transition to live phone audio editorially without adding dialogue.

In c11 and c12, b6 is divided into consecutive parts: first the glance and return of the eyes to the road, then the steer and settled new course. Match hand positions, wrist thread, forward eyeline, dashboard objects, rain and passing reflections at the cut.

Screen photo is a static faded print; do not animate its figures or attempt a mirror. Keep the road movement credible using restrained cabin vibration and passing light; avoid contact, fast finger work and sharp crowds.

Speed ramps, freeze frames, digital punch-ins and split screens are post-only options, not generated movements; the clean held sources permit them if editorially justified, though none is required by this scene. No slow motion or music is planned.

editor_notes: The 86-second must bin supports the 90-second scene target; its overlapping coverage is raw material, not 86 seconds of unique chronological action. Let the editor shape duration from the held driving and reaction material without repeating either line.
Opening master and baseline single establish the passenger-side axis. The photograph detail is an essential scripted reveal; keep it established before the recorded audio starts.

L3 is complete in c05, c06 and c07 and L5 is complete in c09 and c10. These are matching listener pictures under a single uninterrupted instance of each remote line, not multiple playbacks; use the separate source recordings, appropriately filtered, and do not generate visible speech.

The phone is secured in an assumed dashboard cradle and the thread is assigned to Dinu's left wrist because the packet does not specify their exact placement. Both hands stay on the wheel. Do not invent an on-screen answering action.
The incoming screen detail is c08, setup H. Composite the caller ID if generative text is unreliable; transition to live phone audio editorially without adding dialogue.

In c11 and c12, b6 is divided into consecutive parts: first the glance and return of the eyes to the road, then the steer and settled new course. Match hand positions, wrist thread, forward eyeline, dashboard objects, rain and passing reflections at the cut.

Screen photo is a static faded print; do not animate its figures or attempt a mirror. Keep the road movement credible using restrained cabin vibration and passing light; avoid contact, fast finger work and sharp crowds.

Speed ramps, freeze frames, digital punch-ins and split screens are post-only options, not generated movements; the clean held sources permit them if editorially justified, though none is required by this scene. No slow motion or music is planned.
